segments.he: הַמֵּבִיא גֵּט מִמְּדִינַת הַיָּם, וְאָמַר: ״בְּפָנַי נִכְתַּב אֲבָל לֹא בְּפָנַי נֶחְתַּם״; ״בְּפָנַי נֶחְתַּם אֲבָל לֹא בְּפָנַי נִכְתַּב״; ״בְּפָנַי נִכְתַּב כּוּלּוֹ וּבְפָנַי נֶחְתַּם חֶצְיוֹ״; ״בְּפָנַי נִכְתַּב חֶצְיוֹ וּבְפָנַי נֶחְתַּם כּוּלּוֹ״ – פָּסוּל.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who brings a bill of divorce from a country overseas and says:» The bill of divorce «was written in my presence but it was not signed in my presence;» or if he said: «It was signed in my presence but it was not written in my presence;» or: «All of it was written in my presence and half of it was signed in my presence,» i.e., he observed the signing of only one witness; or: «Half of it was written in my presence and all of it was signed in my presence,» in all these cases the document is «invalid.»

segments.he: אֶחָד אוֹמֵר ״בְּפָנַי נִכְתַּב״ וְאֶחָד אוֹמֵר ״בְּפָנַי נֶחְתַּם״, פָּסוּל. שְׁנַיִם אוֹמְרִים ״בְּפָנֵינוּ נִכְתַּב״ וְאֶחָד אוֹמֵר ״בְּפָנַי נֶחְתַּם״, פָּסוּל; וְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה מַכְשִׁיר. אֶחָד אוֹמֵר ״בְּפָנַי נִכְתַּב״ וּשְׁנַיִם אוֹמְרִים ״בְּפָנֵינוּ נֶחְתַּם״, כָּשֵׁר.
segments.en: If «one» agent bringing a bill of divorce «says: It was written in my presence, and one» other agent «says: It was signed in my presence,» it is «invalid.» If «two» agents «say: It was written in our presence, and one says: It was signed in my presence,» it is «invalid. And Rabbi Yehuda deems» the document «valid.» If «one» agent «says: It was written in my presence, and two» agents «say: It was signed in our presence,» it is «valid.»
